markdown/html-comment.md.reason: No two tools agree: cloc counts HTML comments as comments and other lines as code, scc counts every non-blank line as code, and tokei counts every non-blank line as a comment. cloc and scc agree on every other Markdown case (prose is code). Proposed: follow scc, so that a Markdown row's code column is its non-blank lines. Owner to confirm.

python/module-docstring.py.reason: Python docstrings split the tools: cloc counts every triple-quoted string as a comment and a blank line in it as blank; scc counts a docstring as a comment, including its blank lines, and other triple-quoted strings as code; tokei 14 counts docstrings as code. Proposed: follow scc, since it agrees with the majority on every other case (a docstring is a comment, a blank line inside a comment is a comment, an assigned string is code). Owner to confirm.
